resolved_finding.before: The original sizeof4 + trivially copyable/default constructible/copy assignable predicate also accepted a class containing a volatile uint32_t member. Those traits do not express whether class member access has volatile semantics. SIMD representation transfers would bypass the ordinary class/member scalar access route.
resolved_finding.evidence: type_probe.cpp confirms all three traits and sizeof4; a conservative restriction avoids requiring a general detector for volatile members. This review does not claim that every trivial class representation copy is undefined.
resolved_finding.resolution_by_parent: SIMD eligibility additionally requires is_arithmetic_v<Value> || is_enum_v<Value>; class/struct types retain existing scalar/block routes.

matrix_review: Eligibility is nested under the existing trivial type predicates. sizeof4 arithmetic/enum values have no class member volatile access concern; vector<bool> and non-4-byte objects never instantiate the helper.

The SIMD helper writes already constructed output elements, with a separately owned vector for every output row. No source/destination aliasing is possible. Throwing shape checks or allocations destroy temporary ownership and leave the const input unchanged.

GCC AVX headers mark unaligned vector access types may_alias/aligned1. Clang loadu/storeu use packed may_alias wrapper structs. These are supported compiler intrinsic semantics, not a claim that reinterpret_cast vector dereference is portable standard C++.
8x8 row/column permutations match all three modes. h-i>=8 and w-j>=8 protect full loads/stores, scalar loops cover each remaining row/column once. Reverse indices stay in range.

Nonzero h,w are established before threshold h>4095/w, so area threshold has no product overflow or divide-by-zero. 32-row/column gates preserve short/small fallback. All source row lengths are checked before their vector loads.
Target attribute confines AVX2 instructions to the helper; runtime AVX2 builtin gates entry. Function ABI exposes owned vectors and scalar parameters, no 256-bit vector cross-target ABI.

SIRKIT_DISABLE_SIMD excludes intrinsic include, helper definitions, CPU builtin and dispatch references. Compiler/architecture guards preserve standard C++ fallback. No non-AVX2 hardware was independently exercised.
ABC298B actual frozen main uses vector<vector<int>>. Audit correctly distinguishes large matrix API measurements from the small real main and makes no established whole-main gain claim.
radix_review: RadixInteger excludes bool and cv values; accepts only 1/2/4/8-byte full-width integral unsigned representations. The 64-bit scan member is only instantiated from the bytes8 branch; smaller types remain valid.

Overlapping current/previous loads are read-only and remain inside input. Starting at i=1, each 4-lane block covers adjacent pairs i-1..i+3, and the tail covers remaining pairs and differences. Input vector allocation bounds keep i+4 arithmetic representable on supported implementations.

XOR sign bias converts unsigned64 order to signed lane comparisons. Raw XOR against first equals signed-key XOR because a fixed sign bias cancels. Ordered/reversed flags and aggregate variation therefore match scalar formulas.

The first item, all SIMD lanes and every scalar tail are covered by maximum checks before large-input mutation. SKIP_RUNTIME_CHECKS preprocesses out check-only accumulators. Small insertion-sort exception behavior remains the existing contract.

Deferred Histogram initialization is safe: ordered/reversed return before reading counts, while unordered initializes all histograms before scatter. Unordered input has nonzero variation, so active byte count cannot be zero on the optimized path.
The SIMD scan allocates nothing and writes only local already-live lane storage. Workspace ownership and scatter capacity/storage behavior are unchanged. Unsigned shifts remain within bit width.

Target/CPU/disable requirements are consistent with matrix. Existing default/natively vectorized comparisons and first-call/main distinction are recorded; ABC331C whole-main gain is not established and is not asserted.

supplemental_fallback_test.description: VolatileBox class size4 with all three original traits; matrices64x65,65x64,63x129,129x63. Independent index equations for transpose/CW/CCW and unchanged input. Each executable nm checked for absent matrix_turn_avx2 instantiation and absent CPU indicator symbols.
limitations: GCC ASan link environment lacks libasan; sanitizer coverage uses Clang.
Clang ASan/UBSan passes with detect_leaks=0 because LeakSanitizer is unavailable under this sandbox ptrace environment. Existing parent fault-injection tests cover ownership.

independent_review.not_repeated: Existing broad references, allocation faults and fixed-main suites were read rather than mechanically rerun; supplemental test targets the independently identified type boundary.
